name: Aadam
title: Forward deployed engineer, Accra
short: Aadam is a forward deployed engineer in Accra. He embeds with operators, analysts and coaches and ships the systems they run on: 20+ in production for 17 businesses, from point of sale and ERP to investment models and brands.
long: Aadam is a software engineer and analyst based in Accra, Ghana. He studied mathematics at the University of Mines and Technology and information technology at the International Open University, then spent three years in Ghanaian private equity and venture capital, taking 50+ SMEs from sourcing to Investment Committee. He now works forward deployed: he sits in with a business, studies how money, stock and people really move, and builds the system it runs on. His work includes the Al Boyut point of sale and storefront, PrimeTijara's supply desk (GHS 177K in its first month), Delish on Odoo, the Bloom Boba brand and the Madina Basketball court platform, for which he also co-led a GHS 40,000+ community renovation. He works remotely across European and US hours.
